day_shape: 46 items: Ghalibaf tells Iran International authorities rushed to announce Khamenei's death after opposition media broke news, IRIB sets Tuesday funeral for three killed in US Qeshm strike, IDF reports five Hamas depots destroyed and an officer wounded in south Lebanon, heavy Arbaeen messaging cycle from IRIB/Defa Press, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Fallout from Khamenei succession announcement
threads.summary: Iran International reported parliament speaker Ghalibaf saying authorities rushed to announce Ali Khamenei's death and mobilise supporters after 'overseas media' broke the news, fearing street unrest. Pezeshkian posted that 'Iran's future will be determined by the Iranian people,' referencing two years of 'imposed wars' since the assassination of the group's 'dear guest.'

threads.label: US Qeshm strike aftermath and Iranian military posture
threads.summary: IRIB announced Tuesday funerals in Qeshm for three killed in what it called the 'barbaric US attack' on the Chah Tangoo neighbourhood, with burial from Qasem Soleimani Square. Defa Press quoted the army spokesman claiming new drones were used to strike US bases and citing rebuilding during the ceasefire; the acting defence minister said the defence industry 'must move faster than the battlefield.'

threads.label: IDF operations in Gaza and south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet announced overnight airstrikes destroyed five Hamas weapons depots in Gaza, including one adjacent to Shuhada al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir al-Balah, storing rifles, explosives and anti-tank launchers. The IDF separately said an officer was moderately wounded during 'operational activity' in southern Lebanon, with circumstances not disclosed.

threads.label: Arbaeen pilgrimage logistics and messaging
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press ran a heavy Arbaeen cycle: the Central Arbaeen Headquarters reported over 3 million pilgrims crossing to Iraq (47% via Mehran), the Red Crescent claimed 1.65 million services delivered with no disease outbreaks, and Tehran's prosecutor blocked three travel agencies over ticket overpricing. Khamenei's office posted a message framing Arbaeen as 'Love of Hussain unites us,' referencing pilgrims travelling by proxy for 'martyred Iran.'

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz posture and Sulaymaniyah explosions
threads.summary: Defa Press quoted parliament security commission spokesman Qashqavi saying 'Iranian arrangements for passage through the Strait of Hormuz are the only option on the table,' whether via escalation or negotiation. IRIB and Defa Press also relayed unverified Arabic-source reports of explosion sounds in Sulaymaniyah, Iraq.

events.title_en: Controversial memo from US Treasury Secretary; is Washington seeking to buy billions in Japanese yen?
events.summary_en: Controversial memo from US Treasury Secretary; is Washington seeking to buy billions in Japanese yen? A Reuters photo shows a notebook of Scott Bessent, US Treasury Secretary, at a cabinet session with the words written on it: 'Things to do: Buy 5 to 10 billion dollars in Japanese yen.' This image was released shortly after a report stating that the US Treasury Department had notified banks of the possibility of intervention in the currency market. If Washington carries out this purchase, it would be the first US intervention to support the value of the Japanese yen since 2011. However, the US Treasury Department has not yet confirmed whether such a purchase has actually been carried out.

The Ka-31 helicopter is one of the few specialised early-warning helicopters in the world, designed to provide beyond-horizon radar coverage to naval strike groups. events.title_en: Who benefits from Spain's events?
events.summary_en: Who benefits from Spain's events? Rasoul Hussain Abu Al-Sobh: Migration is no longer merely a humanitarian issue and has become one of the most effective tools of pressure in international relations. In international politics, meaningless coincidences do not exist and sensitive cases never move separate from the balance of power. When suddenly borders open to tens of thousands of young people seeking a way to reach Europe, the main question is not 'what happened?', but rather 'who benefits from this event occurring at this time?'. The Spanish city of Ceuta, a Moroccan city under Spanish administration, witnessed an unprecedented wave of entry of tens of thousands of Moroccan citizens...

events.summary: 💢 حمله ارتش به پایگاه‌های آمریکا با پهپاد‌های جدید 🔸 سخنگوی ارتش گفت: با توجه به سابقه بدعهدی آمریکا و نقض تفاهم‌نامه، تلاش کردیم از لحظه به لحظه آتش‌بس حداکثر استفاده را به لحاظ تأمین و واردات تجهیزات یا به لحاظ بازسازی و تولید سامانه‌های جدید ببریم. 🔸 ما اخیراً از پهپاد‌های نوع جدیدی استفاده کردیم که مشخصات آن در روز‌های آینده اعلام خواهد شد. 🔸 العدید در عملیات‌های هوایی آمریکا علیه کشورمان نقش مهمی داشته است؛ اما ما توانستیم ظرف تنها ۴۸ ساعت پس از شروع تجاوز دشمن، ضربه محکمی به این پایگاه وارد کنیم. پس از آن نیز این پایگاه توسط پهپاد‌ها و موشک‌ها، ضربات سنگین دیگری دریافت کرده است. dnws.ir/
events.title_en: Army strikes US bases with new drones
events.summary_en: Army strikes US bases with new drones. The army spokesman said: Given America's history of breaking its word and violating agreements, we tried to make maximum use of the moment-to-moment ceasefire in terms of procuring and importing equipment or in terms of rebuilding and producing new systems. We recently used a new type of drone, the specifications of which will be announced in the coming days. Al-Udeid played an important role in American air operations against our country, but we managed to strike this base forcefully within just 48 hours of the start of the enemy's aggression. After that, this base also received other heavy blows from drones and missiles.
